dogecoin.text:
Its become clear that $doge isn't going to crash any time soon, and I can afford to invest another $450 towards it.

I went ahead and sold all my BTC, ($450 worth), and doubled down on Dogecoin. If it all goes to hell, I will still be okay. But I highly doubt that it will crash!
So Dogecoin is on the rise yet again, and the only thing that I can come up with to do about it is to keep my cool, and do absolutely nothing
